subsystems.name: agent-metadata-registry
subsystems.note: The registry is a runtime global seam consumed by adapters; Codemap can follow imports but cannot model module-evaluation ordering or shared registry identity.

subsystems.name: capability-bridge-protocol
subsystems.note: Bridge message names and the numeric handshake are a string-and-shape seam across server code and a future browser client; no import edge reaches an external client.

subsystems.name: protocol-compatibility-matrix
subsystems.note: The matrix is a deliberately data-only compatibility statement; keeping it near the registry lets tests catch protocol status drift without adding transport dependencies.
